Expected values read by hand from section 3.1 on 3 Nov 2026: the base FSR of 0.60 (3.1.1.1; the Director's 0.75 and 0.95 and the 1.00 for multiple dwelling with 25% non-profit units under 3.1.1.2 are conditions, not the maximum); height 10.7 m and 3 storeys (3.1.2.3); the minimum front yard is the average of the adjacent sites, so no number is expected; side yard 1.5 m where the site exceeds 15 m, else 10% of the width (3.1.2.6); rear yard 20.0 m (3.1.2.7); site coverage 45% (3.1.2.8).
